newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungarian O/N rates close firmer at 20.75 percent.
newsitem.headline: Hungarian O/N rates close firmer at 20.75 percent.

text.p: Hungarian overnight rates closed higher on Thursday at 20.75 percent compared with Wednesday's 20.375 percent close, traders said.
Market expectations of a further repo rate cut by the central bank could keep rates relatively high.

"The market expects another 0.25 percent cut in the first half of March, so all available funds are likely to end up in the (central bank's) reverse repo facility," said Sandor Tolonics of Commerzbank.
The central bank last cut four of its five repo rates on February 17, bringing the benchmark one-week reverse repo to 21 percent. -- Denes Albert, Budapest newsroom +36 1 327 4040
